explore-instruction: Click a word or a part of Pelle's body to match them! All words are in singular.
explore-audio-hint-level1: Want to hear the pronunciation? Click the word or body part again once it is selected.
level2-instruction: Click on the body part that matches the word! A correct answer on the first try gives one point. If you get it wrong, you get one more try before the answer is shown.
explore-audio-hint-level2: Want to hear the pronunciation? Click the word.
not-implemented-prompt: This level is not yet implemented.
exit-confirmation: ARE YOU SURE YOU WANT TO QUIT THIS GAME?
purpose: The purpose of the Pelle from head to toe is to learn swedish words for body parts and practice their usage of "en"/"ett".
how-to-play: On each level, you will practice on swedish words for body parts by either clicking on them, pairing them together or writing them yourself
l1-description: Click around on body parts and words to see which match together
l2-description: Click on Pelles body parts based on which word is display
additional-info: If you are unsure about the vocabulary, you can always replay a level or check the word list in the provided material. The game is designed to be fun while reinforcing Swedish language learning.
